/**
 * A client for communicating with a Microsoft Exchange server.
 *
 * This interface is intended to provide an abstraction of Exchange operations to
 * bridge the foreign function interface between the components of a Thunderbird
 * mail protocol implementation and a single implementation of those Exchange ops.
 *
 * With the exception of initialization, all client operations are intended to
 * be asynchronous, with implementations of the callback interfaces used to
 * handle the results of the operations or handle errors.
 */
[scriptable, uuid(4a117361-653b-48a5-9ddb-588482ef9dbb)]
interface IExchangeClient : nsISupports
{
  /**
   * Whether the client is currently running.
   *
   * This will be false if `initialize()` hasn't been called yet, or if
   * `shutdown()` has been called.
   *
   * The client is considered running if it's either performing operations, or
   * waiting for new ones.
   */
  readonly attribute boolean running;

  /**
   * Whether the client is not currently processing any operation and is fully
   * waiting for one to be triggered.
   *
   * If `running` is `false`, then `idle` will also be `false`.
   */
  readonly attribute boolean idle;

  /**
   * Initializes a new client with the necessary host address and authentication
   * details to communicate with an Exchange server.
   *
   * @param endpoint - The HTTP(S) address of an Exchange server's endpoint.
   * @param server - An incoming server entity corresponding to an Exchange-capable
   *   account.
   */
  void initialize(
